name: ScreenSafe
author: Jeremy Dixon
description: Screensavers made of data, not code: ASCII art, line art and images, drawn sharp on every screen.

barWidget.description: Choose the screensaver and when it starts, switch it on for idle, or preview it.

schema.label: Enable
schema.description: Show ScreenSafe instead of Omarchy's screensaver when you're idle.

schema.label: Starts after (seconds)
schema.description: Seconds idle before ScreenSafe shows, from 10; 0 follows Omarchy's screensaver time.
